articles.title: These 5 quirks reveal how AI doesn’t think like we do
articles.snippet: The differences between human and AI learning and reasoning lead to some strange bot behaviors.
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence learns and reasons differently than humans, which leads to some strange bot behaviors. These differences show that AI does not think the same way we do.

articles.title: This ‘anti-vampiric’ grave was double guarded against the undead
articles.snippet: A sickle across the throat and a padlock on her toe were meant to keep a 17th-century teen girl from resurrecting from the grave.
articles.summary: A 17th-century teenage girl was buried with a sickle across her throat and a padlock on her toe to stop her from coming back from the dead. These unusual items were used as double protection against the undead.
